import csv, json
from collections import defaultdict
import openpyxl
ledger = list(csv.DictReader(open("/app/input/passage_ledger.csv")))
ws = openpyxl.load_workbook("/app/input/edit_register.xlsx")["Log"]
head = [c.value for c in ws[1]]
log = [dict(zip(head, r)) for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True) if r[0]]
# each decision read against the About sheet: (call, lines the decision gives or None)
MEANING = {
    "Yes, take it.": ("ACCEPTED", None), "Agreed.": ("ACCEPTED", None), "Fine as proposed.": ("ACCEPTED", None),
    "Yes, cut the whole sequence.": ("ACCEPTED", None), "Yes, the whole interlude goes.": ("ACCEPTED", None),
    "Author says go ahead.": ("ACCEPTED", None),
    "Yes, but only five lines out, not seven.": ("ACCEPTED", -5),
    "Yes, but six lines, not four.": ("ACCEPTED", 6),
    "Yes, and take the next three lines with it: twelve out.": ("ACCEPTED", -12),
    "Park until the author has read it.": ("DEFERRED", None),
    "On reflection, leave this for the author.": ("DEFERRED", None),
    "No. The list of ship names stays out.": ("WITHDRAWN", None),
    "No. The author wants the interlude kept.": ("WITHDRAWN", None),
    "Withdrawn: the letter stays as drafted.": ("WITHDRAWN", None),
    "Back to Ines's call.": ("RETURN", "Ines"),
}
assert all(l["decision"] in MEANING for l in log), [l["decision"] for l in log if l["decision"] not in MEANING]
call, history = {}, defaultdict(list)          # an edit's latest decision is its call
for l in log:
    code = l["edit_code"]
    kind, arg = MEANING[l["decision"]]
    if kind == "RETURN":                       # stands as that reader's earlier call did
        c = dict([h for h in history[code] if h[0] == arg][-1][1])
    else:
        number = l["proposed_change"] if code not in call else call[code]["change"]
        c = {"passage": l["passage_id"], "state": kind, "change": arg if (kind == "ACCEPTED" and arg is not None) else number}
    call[code] = c
    history[code].append((l["reader"], dict(c)))
edits = defaultdict(list)
for c in call.values():
    edits[c["passage"]].append(c)
page = lambda line: (line - 1) // 30 + 1
rows, counts, line = [], defaultdict(int), 1
for p in ledger:
    mine = edits[p["passage_id"]]
    length = int(p["drafted_lines"]) + sum(c["change"] for c in mine if c["state"] == "ACCEPTED")
    floored = length < 1
    length = max(length, 1)                    # held at 1 line; that line still pushes the rest down
    first, last = line, line + length - 1
    if floored:
        v = "LENGTH_FLOORED"
    elif any(c["state"] == "DEFERRED" for c in mine):   # withdrawn leaves nothing open
        v = "EDIT_DEFERRED"
    else:
        v = "STRADDLES_BREAK" if page(first) != page(last) else "WHOLLY_ON_PAGE"
    counts[v] += 1
    rows.append((p["passage_id"], page(first), v))
    line = last + 1
with open("/app/page_register.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n"); w.writerow(["passage_id", "page_number", "verdict"]); w.writerows(rows)
res = {"straddling_passage_count": counts["STRADDLES_BREAK"], "deferred_edit_count": counts["EDIT_DEFERRED"],
       "length_floored_count": counts["LENGTH_FLOORED"], "wholly_on_page_count": counts["WHOLLY_ON_PAGE"],
       "final_page_count": page(line - 1)}
open("/app/results.json", "w").write(json.dumps(res, indent=2) + "\n")
PYEOF
